annotations.title: Natural disasters happening near a place

description:
Natural disasters and hazards happening now or recently near a place, every one the sources hold: wildfires (NASA FIRMS satellite fire detections), every earthquake USGS records with its depth, felt reports, intensity and PAGER alert, tsunami bulletins of the NOAA warning centres, tropical cyclones with the official NHC cone and forecast track, floods, volcanic eruptions and droughts (GDACS), official warnings for every natural hazard from the US National Weather Service and, through WMO WIS2, from MeteoAlarm's national services across Europe (wind, snow and ice, thunderstorms, fog, heat, cold, coastal, rain, flood, fire danger, avalanche), and air quality (OpenAQ reference monitors).

Use it for what is happening there now. For the weather forecast use get_forecast; for long-term exposure, get_climate_profile.

Returns the most severe and most recent events first, each with its kind (occurrence or warning), type, severity (low to critical), distance, bearing and time; a warning also carries its issuer (sender), issued_at, onset_at and expires_at and whether the place lies inside its area (inside), and a moving storm its track. total and counts_by_type cover every event found. radius_km (1 to 500), event_types and days (1 to 30) narrow the search; without radius_km every type is searched at its largest distance, which radius_used_km reports. Give latitude and longitude, or a place name.

days.description: Only events of the last N days, 1 to 30; all current when omitted
days.title: Days

event_types.description: Only these kinds of event; every kind when omitted
event_types.title: Event Types

latitude.description: Latitude of the place asked about, in degrees, WGS84. Give it with longitude, or give place instead
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: Longitude of the place asked about, in degrees, WGS84. Give it with latitude, or give place instead
longitude.title: Longitude

place.description: A place name or address, used only when latitude and longitude are not given. It is resolved to its best match by a geocoder shared by every user and limited to one lookup a second, so pass coordinates when you have them
place.title: Place

radius_km.description: Search radius in km, 1 to 500; the largest when omitted
radius_km.title: Radius Km

name: get_hazards_near

active_at.description: The latest moment the source reports it active
active_at.title: Active At

bearing_deg.description: Degrees clockwise from north, from the place to the event
bearing_deg.title: Bearing Deg

expires_at.description: When the source says it ends; null when it states none
expires_at.title: Expires At

inside.description: Whether the place lies in the area the record covers, such as a warning's: a warning's position is a point inside its area, so its distance says little. Null for a record with no area
inside.title: Inside

issued_at.description: When the source issued this record
issued_at.title: Issued At

issuer_text.description: A warning's headline, description and instruction as the issuing service published them for the public, attributed to its sender. Null when the source gives none
issuer_text.title: Issuer Text

kind.description: occurrence (something happening), warning (an authority's message about an area) or status
kind.title: Kind

metadata.description: What the source says beyond the value. A USGS earthquake carries depth_km, magnitude_type, felt_reports (Did You Feel It? reports), cdi and mmi (felt and ShakeMap intensity), pager_alert and review_status; a NOAA tsunami bulletin its centre, magnitude, origin_time and depth_km; an NHC storm its max_wind_kt, pressure_mb and movement; a MeteoAlarm warning its awareness_level (yellow, orange, red) and awareness_type
metadata.title: Metadata

sender.description: The issuing authority, when the source relays many
sender.title: Sender

track.description: A moving event's positions, oldest first: kind observed where it was seen, forecast where the source expects it
track.title: Track

data.description: The most severe and most recent events
data.title: Data

radius_used_km.description: The distance searched for each event type
radius_used_km.title: Radius Used Km

resolved_from.description: What a place name was resolved to; null when coordinates were given
resolved_from.title: Resolved From
